baseline.note: Release 461 is the already-proven schema baseline. Historical files in migrations/dev are provenance only and are never replayed by this canonical stream.

migrations.description: Bootstrap the forward-only canonical migration proof authority used alongside Cloudflare D1's native d1_migrations ledger.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only. Restore the pre-migration D1 backup if required, or repair with a new numbered migration. Never edit or replay this migration after Development application.

migrations.description: Add migration-owned operational retention archive review and audited safe-recovery evidence for Update 2.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only. Restore the pre-migration D1 backup if required, or repair retention/recovery authorities with a new numbered migration. Never edit this migration after Development application.

migrations.description: Add scheduled Storefront merchandising rules and the cross-module Creative-to-Storefront business pipeline spine.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only additive tables. Disable rules or archive pipeline rows for logical rollback; restore the pre-migration D1 backup only for unrecoverable schema integrity failure.

migrations.description: Make Product publication hard-readiness migration-owned and add fail-closed SEO/readiness guards for Release 465 Build 1.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only. Unpublish affected Products before any corrective migration; repair or replace Release 465 publication triggers only with a new numbered migration. Never edit this migration after Development application.

migrations.description: Add a shared workshop-process catalog and one reviewed primary process assignment for each Tool or Supply inventory item.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only additive tables. Clear or reassign process links for logical rollback; repair schema defects only with a new numbered migration and never edit this migration after Development application.

migrations.description: Correct the Release 465 activation trigger so legacy active Products can repair media safely while preserving publication-boundary and no-degradation guards.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only trigger correction. If the guard semantics require further repair, add a new numbered migration; never edit this migration after Development application.

migrations.description: Add explicit admin-owned launch-set remediation review metadata: owner, status, due note, official recheck evidence and completion evidence.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only additive table. Logical rollback leaves Product/Inventory facts untouched; archive or supersede remediation metadata as needed. Repair schema defects only with a new numbered migration and never edit this migration after Development application.

migrations.description: Extend the existing inventory_processes workshop taxonomy for the full multi-discipline maker/manufacturing capability set while preserving all Build 156 process keys and reviewed Tool/Supply assignments.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only reference-taxonomy expansion. Existing process keys and inventory assignments remain intact. Correct taxonomy defects only with a new numbered migration; never edit this migration after Development application.

migrations.description: Add reviewed workshop capability profiles linked to canonical process keys, with source notes, explicit unknown/measured constraint state, customer-supplied assessment policy, proof/sample policy and public/admin routing.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only additive table. Hide or hold profiles for logical rollback; correct facts only through reviewed admin updates or a new numbered migration. Never edit this migration after Development application.

migrations.description: Enrich the existing custom_requests authority with structured quantity, project intent, intended use, organisation/event context, supplied-item, material/finish, personalization, capability preference, size/tolerance and help-me-choose fields.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only additive columns and indexes. Existing requests and status/quote/order journeys remain intact. Correct schema defects only with a new numbered migration; never edit this migration after Development application.

migrations.description: Add staff-reviewed manufacturing triage and ordered candidate-process route proposals linked to existing custom_requests and canonical inventory_processes.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only additive tables. Logical rollback archives/clears triage and candidate-route evidence only; customer requests and canonical process identity remain intact. Repair schema defects only with a new numbered migration.

migrations.description: Add ordered multi-process Creative Project operation plans, explicit operation dependencies and planned Inventory resource references while preserving Creative Process, Inventory and CAIP ownership.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only additive tables. Logical rollback retires operation plans or removes planning-only dependency/resource links; actual Creative Process events, Inventory movements, CAIP media and Finance records remain untouched. Repair schema defects only with a new numbered migration.

migrations.description: Add versioned private Custom Work proof records and append-only approval/change-request event history with optional Packaging-version and customer-safe stage-photo references.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only additive tables. Logical rollback supersedes/expires proof versions while retaining audit history; Packaging, CAIP/media, Custom Work and publication authorities remain independently owned. Repair schema defects only with a new numbered migration.

migrations.description: Add explicit prototype/sample/production maturity lifecycle and append-only transition evidence over existing Creative Process, Custom Work and Build 213 proof authorities.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only additive tables. Logical rollback records a superseding lifecycle transition; never delete failed prototype or approval history. Repair schema defects only with a new numbered migration.

migrations.description: Extend existing Custom Work quote drafts with structured small-batch/corporate/event assumptions and quantity tiers while retaining existing quote revisions, line items, payment gates and order drafts.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only additive tables. Logical rollback stops using/supersedes batch quote terms and tiers; existing quote drafts, revisions, line items, payment and order authorities remain intact. Repair schema defects only with a new numbered migration.

migrations.description: Extend existing Custom Work with customer-supplied item identity, append-only suitability reviews, links to existing intake/post-work media evidence, and explicit limitation acknowledgement without duplicating triage or media authorities.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only additive tables. Logical rollback stops creating new supplied-item records/reviews/acknowledgements while retaining existing evidence history. Repair schema defects only with a new numbered migration.

migrations.description: Add nullable Creative Project manufacturing source evidence for operation-level time, direct-cost components, failed prototypes and actual produced/accepted quantities while preserving Inventory and Finance/Accounting ownership.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only additive table. Void incorrect evidence rows while retaining history; do not rewrite Inventory or Finance/Accounting facts. Repair schema defects only with a new numbered migration.

migrations.description: Add versioned reviewed manufacturing job-traveler snapshots and append-only traveler events over existing Custom Request, Creative Project, proof/sample, operation/resource, supplied-item and Packaging/handoff authorities.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only additive traveler evidence. Void or supersede traveler versions for logical rollback; source authorities remain untouched. Repair schema defects only with a new numbered migration and never edit this migration after Development application.

migrations.description: Add reviewed production-run outcome evidence with per-operation timestamps/outcomes, QA checks, links to existing Inventory postings, and finished-inventory/order handoff references while preserving Inventory and Finance/Accounting ownership.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only additive evidence tables. Void incorrect reviewed runs and record a corrected run; do not rewrite Inventory movements, order authority or Finance/Accounting facts. Repair schema defects only with a new numbered migration.

migrations.description: Add a reviewed internal Workshop Knowledge Library linking source-backed material/tool Inventory identities, canonical workshop processes, observed settings, constraints/outcomes, Creative Project provenance and reference-only evidence.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only additive knowledge tables. Void incorrect reviewed knowledge entries while retaining provenance; never rewrite source Creative Project, Inventory, process or media authorities. Repair schema defects only with a new numbered migration.

migrations.description: Add reviewed Project-to-Knowledge promotion with immutable recipe version snapshots, exact Creative Project/operation provenance, canonical process/Inventory identities, observed settings, failure history and explicit supersession.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only additive recipe history. Supersede or void incorrect recipe versions while retaining provenance; never rewrite source Creative Project, Inventory, process or media authorities. Repair schema defects only with a new numbered migration.

migrations.description: Close the measured 21/22 public capability-profile coverage gap by adding one reviewed Photography & Content profile for the existing canonical photography-content process; no schema change or parallel taxonomy.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only reference-data extension. Correct through the existing Build 209 reviewed capability authority or a new forward migration; never edit this migration after Development application.

migrations.description: Add five owner-authorized editable 2 × 2 inch Soap Cupcake label system templates (Sweet Orange, Charcoal, Oatmeal & Goat Milk, Sea Breeze, Lavender Dream) to the existing Packaging authority without changing existing projects.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only additive reference templates. Deactivate or supersede a template for logical rollback; do not rewrite existing Packaging projects. Correct template facts with a later numbered migration.
